tabs.html:
BenQ RD240Q 24.1” 2K+ WQXGA Programming Monitor – Built for Coders and Creators

Upgrade your coding experience with the BenQ RD240Q 24.1-inch 2K+ WQXGA Programming Monitor, designed specifically for developers, programmers, and professionals who need precision, comfort, and productivity in one display. With a high-resolution 2560 x 1600 (WQXGA) panel and a 16:10 aspect ratio, this monitor offers 11% more vertical screen space than standard 16:9 monitors—perfect for reading long code files, comparing documents, or multitasking efficiently.


High Resolution 2K+ WQXGA (2560x1600)

Sharp, crisp visuals ideal for programming, UI/UX design, and content editing.

24.1” IPS Display with 16:10 Aspect Ratio

More vertical space means less scrolling when coding or reading documentation.

95% DCI-P3 Color Gamut + HDR10 Support

Vivid, color-accurate display for creative professionals and developers alike.

Dedicated Coding Modes

Optimized for readability with enhanced contrast for syntax highlighting.

USB-C Port with 90W Power Delivery

Connect and charge your laptop or MacBook with a single cable.

Multiple Connectivity Options

Includes HDMI 2.0, DisplayPort 1.4, 3x USB 3.2, and audio output for full flexibility.

Ergonomic Stand

Height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments for ideal posture and long-hour comfort.

Eye-Care Technology

Features Low Blue Light, Flicker-Free, and Brightness Intelligence Gen2 to reduce eye strain.

Eco-Friendly Build

Made from 85% post-consumer recycled plastics and shipped in sustainable packaging.


Why Choose BenQ RD240Q?

This monitor is ideal for:

  • Software developers & programmers
  • IT professionals and system administrators
  • Designers who need vertical screen space
  • Remote workers looking for ergonomic setups
